insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Hapad US delivered $18,402 in total sales for Week 45 on 1,177 units, versus $19,130 the prior week (-3.8% WoW). Organic revenue grew 2.4% to $11,436, and the Metatarsal Pad 3/8" Large 6-Pack rose to $2,032 (+34.8%) with CVR up 52.3%. Monday, Nov 2 was the peak day at $3,085.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Metatarsal Pad 5/16" Medium 6-Pack remains the top seller at $5,077 (-2.8%), with sessions up 7.1% but CVR down 8.2% to 28.2%. The Metatarsal Pad 1/4" Small 6-Pack eased to $1,655 (-6.8%) on CVR of 20.1% (-23.4%), so we are focused on converting its 19.7% session growth into sales.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $3,254 (prior $3,068) generated $6,965 in PPC revenue (-12.5%), for a 2.14x ROAS versus 2.59x and a 46.7% ACOS. TACoS moved to 17.7% from 16.04%, while ad conversion stayed strong at 17.32% on a 0.69% ad CTR.

**Actions This Week —** We will lower bids on high-ACOS targets and audit search terms to bring ACOS down from 46.7% and lift ROAS back toward 2.59x. We will reallocate budget to proven converters like the Posting Heel Wedge (36.8% CVR) and the 1-Pair Medium Metatarsal Pad (24.7% CVR), and test new ad creative to grow ad CTR above 0.69%.
